# edstem-cli 0.8.6

The hosted MCP server's sign-in pages get a redesign.

- The authorize page now uses the same consent page as the other study tools: Ed's own icon, what the client can see, an optional write toggle, and a Deny button that tells the client you said no.
- The "Sign in again" and "Ed disconnected" pages use the matching message page.
- Ed's icon is fetched from Ed's site and inlined, so the page still loads nothing from other hosts.

The CLI and MCP tools are unchanged from 0.8.5.
